brief: AVATR 07L i 06T trebalo bi da stignu u Srbiju do kraja 2026, preko Delta Auto Grupe
Cene, oprema i datum početka prodaje za Srbiju još nisu objavljeni
The AVATR 07L and 06T should reach Serbia by the end of 2026, through Delta Auto Grupa
Prices, equipment and a sales start date for Serbia have not been published yet
